program: CF-1 routing tick, alternating order, mass option M1 (kind Y)
field: links of axis 2 carry exp(i B x1); forward transport x -> x+e2 multiplies by conj(z), backward by z (public seam form)
units: cells and ticks; phases in radians per tick
clock: ticks; return amplitude sampled every two ticks (time-independent two-tick operator), phases halved
preparation_lines: one cell column (64,64,both x3) with blank record, spin up or down
preparation_orbit: Gaussian amplitude exp(-r^2/(2 w^2)), w = sqrt(2/B), kinetic momentum p0 along axis 1, coin = positive_coin((p0,0,0), theta) (blank spin-up projected on the one-axis positive branch), then projected on the eigenstates of U2 with phases >= 0
sublattices: a quantum moves by (+-1,+-1,+-1) per tick, so (x1-x2) mod 2 and (x2-x3) mod 2 are conserved: four invariant sublattices. Line preparation (one cell column (64,64), both x3 cells) fills the two sublattices with (x1-x2) mod 2 = 0; the orbit Gaussians fill all four.
